title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final energy value for the proton.

title: Energy Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the invariant mass equation relating the energies and momenta of the colliding protons.

title: Momentum Consideration
description: Important Criteria: The student must account for the momentum of the moving proton in the calculations.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all energy values are expressed in consistent units, such as GeV.

title: Calculation Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors in calculations, such as sign mistakes or incorrect factor usage.
